description: Cross-session secret reuse (dream's original D10): the user pastes the same fake AWS key an earlier session printed, and a grep over session history finds the literal inside dream-d04's transcript — the corpus db really does hold the credential in both sessions. The catalogue verdict is that reuse across sessions is a leak (masked), so FAIL.
known_gap: cross-session linkage is not gradable: a case binds one session_ref and graders see only that session's evidence, so the case proves the reused credential is present and the reuse claim is visible — it cannot assert that the same token already existed in dream-d04
